content: उपरम् €1 <ab>P.</ab> (Sometimes <ab>Ā.</ab> also) .²1 To cease, end, terminate; संगतावुपरराम च लज्जा <ls>Ki. 9. 44</ls>, <ls n="Ki.">13. 69</ls>; इत्युक्त्वोपरराम; युद्धमुपारमत् ceased <ab>&c.</ab> .²2 To cease or desist from, stop (<ab>oft.</ab> with <ab>pres. part.</ab>); व्यापादयन्नोपरराम <ls>Pt. 1</ls>; or with <ab>abl.</ab>; <ls>Bg. 2. 35</ls>; <ls>Bk. 8. 54</ls>, <ls n="Bk.">9. 51</ls>; or with <ab>inf.</ab>; <ls>Ki. 4. 17</ls>; or by itself; <ls>Bk. 8. 55</ls>. .²3 To be quiet or calm; यत्रोपरमते चित्तम् <ls>Bg. 6. 20</ls>. .²4 To await, wait for; <ls>Śat. Br. 2. 2. 1-2</ls>, <ls n="Śat. Br.">3. 8. 2-29</ls>. .²5 To make quiet (= {%<ab>Caus.</ab>%}). --{%<ab>Caus.</ab>%} To cause to cease, stop, make quiet or still.
